title: Plan your week with 5 prompts

sources.name: Prompting guidance: give constraints and ask for a defined output

caption:
5 prompts to turn a messy to-do list into a realistic week: priorities, time blocks, saying no, a daily top three and a weekly review.
Adjust every plan to your real energy and calendar.
Save this planning set. Comment WEEK and I will send the prompt list.

slides.headline: Dump everything first
body: Write every task and commitment in one messy list.

slides.headline: Find the priorities
body: Let it sort, then you decide.
slides.prompt: Here is my task list: [list]. Group it into must do this week, should do, and can wait. Explain each choice in one line.

slides.headline: Build time blocks
body: Give it your real hours and fixed commitments.
slides.prompt: Make a weekly schedule from [tasks]. I am free [hours]. Fixed commitments: [commitments]. Include breaks and leave 20 percent of the time unscheduled.

slides.headline: Practice saying no
slides.prompt: Write a polite message declining [request] because my week is full. Offer [alternative] or a later date.

slides.headline: Pick a daily top three
body: Three tasks beat a list of twenty.
slides.prompt: From today's tasks [tasks], pick the three most important for [goal]. Put them in order and say what to drop if I run out of time.

slides.headline: Run a weekly review
body: Reflect in five minutes on Friday.
slides.prompt: Ask me five short questions about what went well, what slipped and what to change next week. Then summarize my answers in three bullets.

slides.headline: Plans bend, so leave slack
body: Schedule fewer tasks than you think you can finish.

slides.headline: AI suggests, you choose
body: Adjust the plan to your energy, calendar and priorities.

slides.headline: Save this planning set
body: Comment WEEK and I will send the prompt list.
Share this with someone who plans on Sundays.
